title: fix(metadata-protocol): the orphan adoption keeps overlays of packaged items, and the registry follows each view row it rebinds (#23198)
body:
Fixes #23198

Clause-②: no

This is the second half of #23198, the closing card for the registry-heal family. The first half landed as #23234.

The orphan adoption (`POST /api/v1/packages/ID/adopt-orphans` → `reassignOrphanedMetadata`) now leaves a package-less overlay of a packaged item as it is stored. Each view row it does rebind is written through to the registry with the binding it left, so the one reconcile moves that row's record at once. This was the family's last stored-row write that did not reach the reconcile. The closing check's `bypass` row is gone, and the census no longer has an exception kind.

Direction: PM comment 6144955760 on #23198, which chose option B1 of the `needs_decision` report 6144921283. It is execution under ADR-0070's kernel section: "Overlays of artifact items (`intent = override-artifact`, `allowOrgOverride`) are **unchanged** — they keep their binding to the packaged item they customise."

## What was wrong (measured before the change)

Measured over the real `SchemaRegistry` and the built protocol on a control-plane kernel, at `6f4c518b01`, in an uncommitted scratch in `packages/objectql/src`. A "restart" means a fresh registry with the package registered, then `loadMetaFromDb` over the same rows.

- **Reading A.** A package-less overlay of the packaged container `showcase_task` (`All Tasks (X)`, 6 columns). Adoption rebound it to the base.
  - In the same process, `showcase_task.default` still served `All Tasks (X)`, and two new views were listed next to it.
  - After a restart, the list, the `?object=` list and the by-name read all served `showcase_task.default` as the packaged `All Tasks` (7 columns). The row expanded under its own name in the base instead, as `showcase_task.showcase_task` and `showcase_task.showcase_task.in_progress`.
- **Reading B.** A package-less overlay of one packaged view, `showcase_task.in_progress`. This is the shape of the record list's View Config Save, `PUT /meta/view/NAME?mode=draft` with no package. After adoption and a restart, the list served two entries under that one name.
- **Control D.** A true orphan, the container `rt_ticket` on an object no package owns. Its names and content were unchanged; only `_packageId` moved.

## The change (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`)

1. `reassignOrphanedMetadata` skips a package-less row for which `isArtifactBacked(type, name)` holds. That is the predicate `saveMetaItem` uses to set `intent: 'override-artifact'`, with the type folded the same way the save folds it (`PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`). There is no second derivation.
2. After each successful rebind of a row whose canonical type is `view`, the adoption prepares the row the way the list read does (`storedOverlayEntries`, at the new binding). It then calls `applyRegistryWriteThrough` with `reboundFrom: { packageId: OLD_PACKAGE_ID }`.
   - Rows of other types are still rebound in storage only.
   - If preparing the row fails, the adoption logs a best-effort `warn`, as the write-through itself does, and moves on to the next row.
3. `reboundFrom` passes through `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` and `hydrateExpandedViewItems` (they now share a `HydrationOptions` type) into `reconcileViewExpansions`. Its binding form gains a rebind arm: the record row of the binding the row left is removed, and its names count as the row's old names. Names that the new expansion lacks are healed by the usual per-name walk.
   - It is still one reconcile with its two callers. The closing check's chain pins did not move.
4. The headers of `reassignOrphanedMetadata`, the reconcile, the write-through and `ViewContainerWrite` now say all of this.

No signature, export or schema changed: every changed member is `private`, and `HydrationOptions` is module-local.

## The spec JSDoc stays as it is

`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` reads: "bulk-rebind package-less (orphaned) metadata into this base (ADR-0070 D5)". That is still true after B1:

- The verb still bulk-rebinds orphaned package-less metadata.
- In ADR-0070 an orphan is a runtime-created item ("Every runtime-*created* metadata item is bound to a **writable package**"), and the kernel section carves overlays of artifact items out as "unchanged". An overlay of a packaged item was never an orphan in that record, so a sentence about orphans does not cover it.
- The response's descriptions ("How many orphaned items were adopted.", "Every item that was adopted.") also stay true.

No spec path is touched, so no cross-lane declaration is owed.

## Pins

In `protocol.view-container-reset-expansions.test.ts`, a new block. The harness's `boot` now takes an existing row store, so a restart is `boot({ rows })` plus `loadMetaFromDb`.

- **Reading A:** not adopted (`reassignedCount: 0`), and the row is still package-less. In the same process and after a restart, every door serves `All Tasks (X)`/6, and `showcase_task.showcase_task` is served by none.
- **Reading B:** not adopted. In the same process and after a restart, every door serves `In Progress (X)`/2, once.
- **Control D,** next to the reading A overlay: only `rt_ticket` is adopted. Before any read, the registry entries of the container and of each expanded view carry the base's `_packageId`. Every door serves the views in the same process and after a restart, and the overlay keeps serving.
- **The record moves with the rebind:** a package-less row of the adopted name, written later with no members, heals nothing of the base row's (`rt_ticket.open` and `rt_ticket.closed` stay registered).

Elsewhere:

- `protocol.view-expansion-reconcile-call-sites.test.ts`: the adoption's write is recorded with its route (`sameMember: applyRegistryWriteThrough`). The `bypass` route kind and its test are removed, so a test that would now iterate over nothing does not remain.
- `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts` (#8862): the caller set grows from five to six. The header trace gains route 6, and one case shows that a stored `views` row is written through as `view` and an orphaned `objects` row is not written through at all.

## Ablations

One-shot runs, not kept as files. The fix was committed first. Each leg used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode (the anchor had to hit, and the blob was proven changed) and was restored with `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| leg | mutation | expected | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | the `isArtifactBacked` skip replaced by `true` | A, B, D red | A, B, D red (3 failed, 24 passed) |
| 2 | the adoption never reaches its write-through (the `view` gate always continues) | D and the record pin red | exactly those 2 red |
| 3 | the reconcile's rebind arm off | the record pin red | exactly that 1 red |
| 4 | firing control: a fresh raw `this.engine.update('sys_metadata', …)` in `rollBackUnmanagedImport` | the census red | `the writes in the source are exactly the recorded ones` red, naming `rollBackUnmanagedImport: this.engine.update('sys_metadata'` |
| 5 | premise: `protocol.ts` restored to main's `afbf960c26` | the new pins and the census route red | 5 red: the census same-member route, A, B, D and the record pin |
| 6 | the `view` gate also admits `object` | the #8862 route case red | red |

The first attempt at leg 4 was refused by the tool, because the replacement still contained the anchor; nothing ran. The second attempt ran.

## Tests and gates

All of these were read at head `dc2e536938` (the commit that merges `main` at `4f5679c261`).

- Touched pin files at `dc2e536938`: the reset-expansions file, the census, the #8862 spelling file, the #22057 register-item call sites and the #9111 hydrator pin. 5 files, 55 tests passed (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- The whole `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite ran in two halves before the merge (the merge touches `plugin-sharing` only):
  - 116 files passed and 3 skipped, with 25931 tests passing;
  - 117 of 118 files passed. The one red was the #8862 caller-count pin, which this PR updates. That file was rerun after the update: 12 of 12 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0.
- Real registry, after the fix, with the scratch rerun over the rebuilt dist:
  - A: `reassignedCount 0`, and `All Tasks (X)`/6 on every door in the same process and after a restart;
  - B: `reassigned []`, and `In Progress (X)`/2 once, in the same process and after a restart;
  - D: adopted, and served from `app.home`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `dc2e536938` derives 65 commands. `--ran` reports 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN.
  - `check:dts-closure` first exited 1, naming `plugin-auth`'s `.d.ts`. That run raced my own parallel gate lane, which was rebuilding packages at the time. Rerun on the settled tree, it exited 0 (73 packages, 173 of 173 declarations present).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). Rerun after the builds, it exited 0 (108 entry points across 67 packages load).
- Lint is a declared narrowing. The 4 changed `.ts` files are in `eslint.config.mjs`'s population: `--print-config` resolves a config for each. `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 4 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. Type-aware linting is off (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` in the resolved config), so the verdicts on untouched files cannot move. The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.

Size: 5 files, +282 / −35 against the merge base `4f5679c26`.

## Acceptance notes

- An environment whose only package-less rows are overlays now answers `reassignedCount: 0` and `success: false`. The response shape is unchanged, and the changeset says this.
- Noted, not filed: the boot hydration (`loadMetaFromDb`) registers a package-bound container's own body without the `_packageId` that the list read's hydration stamps on it. So after a restart, the container's bare entry carries no package, while its expanded views do. This PR does not change that difference between the two callers. The control D pin asserts the expanded views after a restart, not the container body.
- Noted, not filed (carried from report 6144921283): the save door accepts a base-bound view named after a shipped view (`showcase_task.in_progress` with `packageId app.home`). The list then serves two bodies under that name, and both wear the shipping package's `_packageId`. Adoption no longer produces that row. It was measured at the protocol layer only, with no other producer measured.
- Two existing pins outside the claim's named region were edited, as listed under Pins: the #8862 caller count with its header trace, and the census header.
